## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Souls-like inspired by Elden Ring, featuring bosses.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Build the game now as a new project.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in `index.html`, using Three.js from a CDN and original low-poly characters, arena, and boss designs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game with two sequential bosses, melee attacks, dodging, stamina, healing, lock-on, keyboard/mouse controls, and touch controls.
- Added an intro screen, HUD, boss health bars, victory/defeat screens, and responsive styling.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`; loaded the game in Playwright without game-script errors.

### Active
- Verify the recent mobile splash-screen control-visibility fix; the latest screenshot appeared to still show touch controls before starting.
- Optionally remove debug screenshots from the repository before wrapping up.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Recheck the mobile intro screen and confirm touch controls appear only after starting; fix if needed.
2. Remove or retain debug screenshots intentionally, check `git status`, then summarize how to play and note the assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/mobile-menu.png`: Debug screenshot; currently appears to show touch controls on the intro screen.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started on port `3002` for browser testing.
- User’s request was: “3D souls-like в стиле Elden Ring с боссами”.
